name: Sunrise
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Sunrise, FL 2026
seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in Sunrise, FL: Light Up the Holidays, Holiday Express Train rides, a family dance, The Nutcracker and a drive-in laser show.
lede: Sunrise celebrates with the city's own events: a free Light Up the Holidays night at the amphitheater, a crafts fair with train rides and Santa, a kids' dance and The Nutcracker at the Civic Center Theatre.
celebrates: The City of Sunrise opens its holiday calendar with Light Up the Holidays at the Sunrise Amphitheater, a free evening with live music, a tree lighting and a drone show, plus a Winter Wonderland for residents with a snow slide and photos with Santa. Its Art of the Season crafts fair at the Village Art Plaza brings free Holiday Express Train rides and a visit from Santa hosted by the Kiwanis Club. The city also runs a Sweet Holidays Family Dance for kids ages 5 to 10 and presents The Nutcracker at the Sunrise Civic Center Theatre. Markham Park hosts a Christmas drive-in laser show.
lastyear: The City of Sunrise says its community comes together to Light Up the Holidays each December, with live music and colorful decorations as the seasonal display is lit. The city's page for the 2026 event describes a Winter Wonderland for Sunrise residents with kids activities, a snow slide and photos with Santa. The city's event calendar also lists The Nutcracker Ballet at the Civic Center Theatre as a reserved-seating holiday show with a G rating.
facts: Sunrise started as a developer's village. The City of Sunrise says it was incorporated in 1961 by Norman Johnson and was originally known as Sunrise Golf Village, which became a tourist destination. Johnson bought about 2,650 acres in southwestern Broward County for the project. In 1971 voters changed the city's name from Sunrise Golf Village to the City of Sunrise.
trains: Sunrise does not have its own Tri-Rail station. Tri-Rail's Broward stops include Cypress Creek, Fort Lauderdale, Fort Lauderdale Airport at 500 Gulf Stream Way in Dania, and Sheridan Street at 2900 Sheridan Street in Hollywood. Metrorail and Metromover run in Miami-Dade County. On a December evening at Village Art Plaza, kids can ride the Holiday Express Train, which the city says is free for kids. For a bigger train day, the Gold Coast Railroad Museum in Miami has over 40 historic rail cars, including the Presidential Rail Car Ferdinand Magellan and Florida East Coast Steam Locomotive #153.

faq: Is there a free Christmas event in Sunrise?

Yes. Light Up the Holidays at the Sunrise Amphitheater is free for everyone, with live music, a tree lighting and a drone show. The Art of the Season crafts fair at Village Art Plaza also has free Holiday Express Train rides for kids and cookie decorating. Winter Wonderland activities are for Sunrise residents only.
Where can kids ride a train in Sunrise?

The City of Sunrise lists free Holiday Express Train rides for kids at its Art of the Season Arts and Crafts Fair at Village Art Plaza on NW 68th Avenue. Santa also visits and gives one free toy to each of the first 100 children, hosted by the Kiwanis Club of Greater Sunrise, Broward.
Do I need to live in Sunrise for Winter Wonderland?

Yes. The city says Winter Wonderland at Light Up the Holidays is for Sunrise residents, who show proof of residency to get wristbands for kids activities and a snow slide. Everyone is free to enjoy the live music, food vendors, the tree lighting and the drone show.
Is there a Christmas show for kids in Sunrise?

The Fort Lauderdale Youth Ballet performs The Nutcracker Ballet at the Sunrise Civic Center Theatre, and the city rates it G, so all ages are admitted. Seats are reserved and cost $35. The theatre's box office sells tickets by phone and in person.

The City of Sunrise says it was incorporated in 1961 by Norman Johnson and was originally known as Sunrise Golf Village. Today it is a Broward County city with its own parks, an amphitheater, a Civic Center Theatre and a large outlet mall, Sawgrass Mills, which opened its first phase in 1990.
